{
  "states": ["Initial", "AcceptingPackets", "RefusingPackets"],
  "transitions": [

      "to": "AcceptingPackets"

      "from": "AcceptingPackets",
      "event": "receive packet with unacceptable CsCov",
      "action": "report Data Dropped 0",
      "to": "AcceptingPackets"
    },
    {
      "from": "AcceptingPackets",
      "event": "receive Change R(Minimum Checksum Coverage, value > 0)",
      "action": "set MinimumCsCov value",
      "to": "AcceptingPackets"
    },
    {
      "from": "Initial",
      "event": "receive Change R(Check Data Checksum, 1)",
      "action": "reset connection",
      "to": "RefusingPackets"
    },
    {
      "from": "Initial",
      "event": "receive Change R(Check Data Checksum, 0)",
      "action": "set CheckDataChecksum 0",
      "to": "AcceptingPackets"
    }
  ]
}
</json>

<json>
{
  "states": ["Idle", "ReceivingData", "CompressingBuffer", "DroppingPackets"],
  "transitions": [
    {
      "from": "Idle",
      "event": "receive packet with Sequence Number > buf_ackno",
      "action": "update buf_head, buf_ackno, buf_nonce",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "receive packet with Sequence Number > buf_ackno and state equals state at head",
      "action": "increment run length",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "receive packet with Sequence Number > buf_ackno and sequence number not expected",
      "action": "enter intervening packets as State 3",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "buffer overflow",
      "action": "compress buffer or transfer to larger buffer",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "buffer overflow",
      "action": "drop all received packets",
      "to": "DroppingPackets"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "receive packet with Sequence Number <= buf_ackno",
      "action": "scan table for byte corresponding to S",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "receive packet with Sequence Number <= buf_ackno and previously lost",
      "action": "change byte's state",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "ReceivingData",
      "event": "receive packet with Sequence Number <= buf_ackno and not lost",
      "action": "ignore packet",
      "to": "ReceivingData"
    },
    {
      "from": "DroppingPackets",
      "event": "buffer shrinks",
      "action": "return to Idle",
      "to": "Idle"
    }
  ]
}
</json>
